001package com.streamconverter.logging;
002
003import java.lang.reflect.Field;
004import java.lang.reflect.Method;
005import java.util.Map;
006import org.slf4j.ILoggerFactory;
007import org.slf4j.Logger;
008import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
009import org.slf4j.MDC;
010import org.slf4j.spi.MDCAdapter;
011
012/**
013 * Installs {@link InheritableMDCAdapter} so that MDC context is automatically propagated to child
014 * threads (including virtual threads) without manual copying.
015 *
016 * <p>Call {@link #initialize()} once at application startup, <em>before</em> the first log
017 * statement, to replace the default Logback MDC adapter. After initialization, MDC values set in a
018 * parent thread are automatically visible in any thread it spawns.
019 *
020 * <p>If {@link InheritableMDCAdapter} is not installed (i.e., {@link #initialize()} was not
021 * called), MDC context will not propagate to child threads. Each thread will have an independent,
022 * empty MDC context.
023 *
024 * <p><strong>Important:</strong> {@code InheritableMDCAdapter} is backed by {@link
025 * java.lang.InheritableThreadLocal}. In environments that reuse threads (for example, servlet
026 * containers or {@link java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService} thread pools), MDC values inherited
027 * for one logical request can unintentionally be visible to a subsequent, unrelated request running
028 * on the same thread unless MDC is reliably cleared. This can lead to log correlation IDs, user
029 * identifiers, or other contextual data "leaking" across requests.
030 *
031 * <p>When using {@link MDCInitializer} together with thread pools, ensure that each task clears MDC
032 * in a {@code finally} block (for example, by calling {@link MDC#clear()} or removing the keys it
033 * set), or wrap submitted {@link Runnable}/{@link java.util.concurrent.Callable} instances so that
034 * MDC is captured, applied for the task execution, and then cleared afterwards.
035 *
036 * <p>Example usage:
037 *
038 * <pre>{@code
039 * public static void main(String[] args) {
040 *     MDCInitializer.initialize();
041 *     // ... rest of application startup
042 * }
043 * }</pre>
044 */
045public final class MDCInitializer {
046
047  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(MDCInitializer.class);
048
049  private MDCInitializer() {}
050
051  /**
052   * Installs {@link InheritableMDCAdapter} into both the SLF4J {@link MDC} class and the Logback
053   * {@code LoggerContext} (if Logback is present on the classpath).
054   *
055   * <p>This method is idempotent: calling it multiple times has no additional effect after the
056   * first call. It is also thread-safe; concurrent calls are serialized.
057   *
058   * <p><strong>Note:</strong> The key-value map of the current thread's MDC context is migrated
059   * into the new adapter. However, deque-based state ({@code pushByKey}/{@code popByKey}) and
060   * values set in other threads are not migrated. For best results, call this method at application
061   * startup before any MDC values are set.
062   *
063   * @throws IllegalStateException if the adapter cannot be installed via reflection
064   */
065  public static synchronized void initialize() {
066    MDCAdapter currentAdapter = MDC.getMDCAdapter();
067    boolean slf4jReady = currentAdapter instanceof InheritableMDCAdapter;
068    boolean logbackReady = isLogbackAlreadyInstalled(currentAdapter);
069
070    if (slf4jReady && logbackReady) {
071      return;
072    }
073
074    Map<String, String> existingContext = MDC.getCopyOfContextMap();
075    InheritableMDCAdapter adapter =
076        slf4jReady ? (InheritableMDCAdapter) currentAdapter : new InheritableMDCAdapter();
077
078    if (!slf4jReady) {
079      installIntoSlf4j(adapter);
080    }
081    if (!logbackReady) {
082      installIntoLogback(adapter);
083    }
084    if (!slf4jReady && existingContext != null) {
085      adapter.setContextMap(existingContext);
086    }
087  }
088
089  /**
090   * Installs the adapter into the SLF4J {@link MDC} class via reflection.
091   *
092   * <p>{@code MDC.setMDCAdapter()} is package-private in SLF4J 2.x, so reflection is the only way
093   * to replace the adapter from outside the {@code org.slf4j} package.
094   */
095  @SuppressWarnings({"PMD.AvoidAccessibilityAlteration", "PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException"})
096  private static void installIntoSlf4j(InheritableMDCAdapter adapter) {
097    // MDC.setMDCAdapter() is package-private in SLF4J 2.x; reflection is the only available path.
098    // RuntimeException は Field.set() が SecurityException 以外をスローする可能性に備えた catch。
099    try {
100      Field mdcAdapterField = MDC.class.getDeclaredField("MDC_ADAPTER");
101      mdcAdapterField.setAccessible(true);
102      mdcAdapterField.set(null, (MDCAdapter) adapter);
103    } catch (ReflectiveOperationException | RuntimeException e) {
104      throw new IllegalStateException("Failed to install InheritableMDCAdapter into SLF4J MDC", e);
105    }
106  }
107
108  /**
109   * Installs the adapter into the Logback {@code LoggerContext} via reflection, if Logback is
110   * present on the classpath.
111   */
112  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
113  private static void installIntoLogback(InheritableMDCAdapter adapter) {
114    // ReflectiveOperationException subtypes vary by JDK version; Exception covers all cases.
115    try {
116      Class<?> loggerContextClass = Class.forName("ch.qos.logback.classic.LoggerContext");
117      ILoggerFactory factory = LoggerFactory.getILoggerFactory();
118      if (loggerContextClass.isInstance(factory)) {
119        Method setMDCAdapter = loggerContextClass.getMethod("setMDCAdapter", MDCAdapter.class);
120        setMDCAdapter.invoke(factory, adapter);
121      }
122    } catch (ClassNotFoundException ignored) {
123      // Logback is not on the classpath; nothing to do
124    } catch (ReflectiveOperationException | RuntimeException e) {
125      throw new IllegalStateException(
126          "Failed to install InheritableMDCAdapter into Logback LoggerContext", e);
127    }
128  }
129
130  /**
131   * Returns {@code true} if the Logback {@code LoggerContext} already has an {@link
132   * InheritableMDCAdapter} installed, or if Logback is not on the classpath.
133   */
134  @SuppressWarnings({"PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException", "PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals"})
135  private static boolean isLogbackAlreadyInstalled(MDCAdapter currentSlf4jAdapter) {
136    // ReflectiveOperationException subtypes vary by JDK version; Exception covers all cases.
137    try {
138      Class<?> loggerContextClass = Class.forName("ch.qos.logback.classic.LoggerContext");
139      ILoggerFactory factory = LoggerFactory.getILoggerFactory();
140      if (!loggerContextClass.isInstance(factory)) {
141        return true; // not Logback — nothing to install
142      }
143      Method getMDCAdapter = loggerContextClass.getMethod("getMDCAdapter");
144      MDCAdapter logbackAdapter = (MDCAdapter) getMDCAdapter.invoke(factory);
145      // == checks instance identity: SLF4J and Logback must share the exact same adapter object,
146      // not just equal values. equals() would incorrectly return true for distinct instances.
147      return logbackAdapter instanceof InheritableMDCAdapter
148          && logbackAdapter == currentSlf4jAdapter;
149    } catch (ClassNotFoundException ignored) {
150      return true; // Logback not on classpath
151    } catch (ReflectiveOperationException | RuntimeException e) {
152      LOGGER.warn("Failed to check Logback MDC adapter; will attempt reinstall", e);
153      return false;
154    }
155  }
156}
